cases.statement: One person: patient 26 in a cohort of 32 children with undifferentiated autoinflammatory disease treated with canakinumab; known only from a table row (male; fever, arthritis, laboratory activity; onset 5.7 y; diagnosis 14.7 y; complete remission on canakinumab).

people.label: Table 3 #26
people.zygosity_or_genotype: heterozygous (cohort-level statement that all variants found were heterozygous)
people.key_phenotypes: fever; arthritis; laboratory inflammatory activity; no rash, serositis, GI, eye, hydrocephalus or hearing loss (Table 3 marks); onset 5.7 y

quotes.quote: Heterozygous genetic variants were found in the remaining 31 patients (97%) in the following genes:

phenotype_specificity.statement: Only table-level data. The cohort was selected as undifferentiated autoinflammatory disease after excluding FMF, TRAPS, MKD and CAPS; NGS panels of 15 or 83 genes (or exome in three patients) were used, and no variants in NLRP3, TNFRSF1A, MVK or MEFV were found. Which test patient 26 had is not stated.

quotes.quote: In our study, patients neither met the Federici criteria nor did they have variants in the NLRP3, TNFRSF1A, MVK, and MEFV genes according to the NGS data.
NGS was performed using a panel of 15 genes in six patients (18%) and using a panel of 83 genes in 24 patients (73%).

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Missense: c.1217A>T predicted p.(Glu406Val). No mechanism statement about this variant.

computational_predictions.statement: No variant-specific scores. The methods (cohort-level) say missense variants were kept when at least three of four tools (SIFT, PolyPhen-1, PolyPhen-2, Mutation Taster) predicted damage.

quotes.quote: Consequently, we separated variants with pathogenicity confirmed by at least three out of four bioinformatic resources: SIFT (damaging), PolyPhen-1 (probably damaging), PolyPhen-2 (probably damaging), and Mutation Tester (disease-causing).

population_data_in_papers.statement: Table 2 gives 'No data' for the gnomAD exomes v2.1.1 minor allele frequency of this variant.

authors_classification.statement: No classification is given for this variant; the paper lists ACMG classes only for named variants in other genes and says most variants overall were of unknown significance (cohort-level).

quotes.quote: Variants with unknown significance were the most frequent, accounting for 35 out of 45 variants (77.8%) among the total identified variants.

concerns: Table-only evidence: no case description, no segregation, no functional data.
Zygosity for patient 26 comes from a cohort-level sentence, not from a statement about him.
The 'Inheritance' column value 'AD' in Table 2 is the gene's inheritance mode, not this family's inheritance.
The cohort is undifferentiated autoinflammatory disease treated with IL-1 blockade; the patient was not diagnosed with HA20 by the authors.
notes_for_panel: Weakest kind of evidence: a single row in a treatment cohort table with the transcript stated (NM_001270508.2, matching the batch).
